description:
Store the actor of a gate run as an `Assignee`, so it is parsed once at decode.

## Background

`GateRunResult.by` is `Option<String>` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:982`), re-parsed into an `Assignee` by `gate_state_from_run` (`commands/gate_check.rs:229-236`). Production writers emit only the automated executor (`gate_execution.rs:175,1513`, `commands/gate_check.rs:56,1225`); the output view copies it (`output.rs:2502,2560`). Every recorded gate-run `by` in this repository is `auto:executor`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GateRunResult.by` is `Option<Assignee>`, and the re-parse in `gate_state_from_run` is gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Gate-run writers use the automated-executor constant.
- [hard] REQ-03: Recorded gate runs in this repository load and re-serialize byte-identically.
title: Gate-run actors are Assignee values
